info.name: Dynamic data per BMU (SEL, SIL, MZT, MNZT, MDV, MDP, NTB, NTO, NDZ)

params.name: bmUnit
params.description: The BM Unit to query.

params.name: snapshotAt
params.description:
When to retrieve a snapshot of data at.
That is, the latest datapoint before this time will be returned for each dataset.

params.name: until
params.description:
When to retrieve data until.
Data from the snapshot until this time will be returned.

params.name: snapshotAtSettlementPeriod
params.description:
The settlement period to retrieve a snapshot of data at.
If provided, the time part of SnapshotAt will be ignored.

params.name: untilSettlementPeriod
params.description:
The settlement period to retrieve data until.
If provided, the time part of Until will be ignored.

params.name: dataset
params.description: Datasets to filter. If omitted, all datasets will be returned.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides the dynamic data for a requested BMU, excluding physical rate data.
It returns a "snapshot" of data valid at a given time, and optionally a time series of changes over a requested interval.
            
By default, all of the relevant datasets are returned: SIL, SEL, NDZ, NTB, NTO, MZT, MNZT, MDV, MDP.
The results from each dataset are transformed to a common response model, with the common integer field *Value*
mapped from the fields *Level*, *Period*, *Volume* or *Notice

params.name: settlementDate
params.description: The settlement date or datetime to filter.

params.description: The settlement period to filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: bmUnit
params.description: The BM Units to query. Elexon or NGC BMU IDs can be used. If omitted, results for all BM units will be returned.

params.name: dataset
params.description: Datasets to filter. If omitted, all datasets will be returned.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.
